title: Intelligent decision-making for mine ventilation systems based on graph neural network and deep reinforcement learning fusion.
summary: GNN-DRL ventilation control is evaluated in simulation and reported as a mine deployment in the full article, with 34.7% higher rewards, 23.7% lower energy and 98.4% safety compliance. The primary text claims field testing for a specific mine ventilation-control problem; scope is case-specific operational evaluation.
organization: Huangyuchuan Coal Mine of Guoneng Yili Energy Co., Ltd.
